title: A Resting Place
text: My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, that it may be well with you?

title: Winnowing Tonight
text: In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

title: Wash and Wear Your Best
text: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes.

title: I Will Do Everything You Say
text: I will do everything you say,

title: She Did Everything
text: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything her mother-in-law had instructed her to do.

title: In Good Spirits
text: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain.

title: At the End of the Heap
text: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits, he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain.

title: At Midnight
text: At midnight, Boaz was startled, turned over, and there lying at his feet was a woman!

title: Your Servant Ruth
text: I am your servant Ruth …

title: A Kinsman-Redeemer
text: Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer.

title: More Kindness Than Before
text: You have shown more kindness now than before, because you have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

title: A Woman of Noble Character
text: … since all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.

title: A Redeemer Nearer Than I
text: Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.

title: As Surely as the LORD Lives
text: But if he does not want to redeem you, as surely as the LORD lives, I will.

title: Before Anyone Could Recognize Her
text: … but she got up before anyone else could recognize her.

title: Six Measures of Barley
text: When she did so, he poured in six measures of barley and placed it on her.

title: How Did It Go?
text: How did it go, my daughter?

title: Not Empty-Handed
text: Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.

title: He Will Not Rest
text: … for he will not rest unless he has resolved the matter today.

title: Boaz Went to the Gate
text: Meanwhile, Boaz went to the gate and sat down there.

title: Ten Elders
text: Then Boaz took ten of the elders of the city and said, “Sit here,” and they did so.

title: Come Over Here, My Friend
text: Come over here, my friend, and sit down.

title: The Land of Elimelech
text: Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.

title: I Am Next after You
text: … because there is no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.

title: Also Ruth the Moabitess
text: On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased …

title: I Cannot Redeem It
text: I cannot redeem it myself, or I would jeopardize my own inheritance.

title: The Sandal
text: So the kinsman-redeemer removed his sandal and said to Boaz, “Buy it for yourself.”

title: Buy It for Yourself
text: Buy it for yourself.

title: You Are Witnesses
text: You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.

title: His Name Will Not Disappear
text: … so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home.

title: Like Rachel and Leah
text: May the LORD make the woman entering your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel.

title: Like the House of Perez
text: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah …

title: Boaz Took Ruth
text: So Boaz took Ruth, and she became his wife.

title: Not without a Kinsman-Redeemer
text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer.

title: He Will Renew Your Life
text: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age.

title: On Her Lap
text: And Naomi took the child, placed him on her lap, and became a nurse to him.

title: Obed
text: The neighbor women said, “A son has been born to Naomi,” and they named him Obed.

title: The Generations of Perez
text: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez was the father of Hezron …

title: Father of David
text: Obed was the father of Jesse, and Jesse was the father of David.

title: In the Line of Jesus
text: Salmon was the father of Boaz by Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed by Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse, and Jesse the father of David the king.

title: Redemption
text: In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace …

title: Winnowing Barley
text: In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

title: Blessed Be the LORD
text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer.

title: Better Than Seven Sons
text: … your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons …

title: A Confirmation in Israel
text: … and this was a confirmation in Israel.

title: Perez
text: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah …
